name: Residual Boundary Algebra completion space — Bellman-information refinement

newly_fixed_or_constrained.statement: The full raw-transition partition shell is not the target RBA abstraction; it is far finer than exact value/action-score semantics on complete controls.
A four-valued UNKNOWN/WIN/DRAW/LOSS Bellman refinement orbit reproduces exact strong state scores by outcome plus first resolution iteration on all complete controls.
The same Bellman refinement reproduces exact strong action scores action-by-action by outcome plus first resolution iteration.
No intermediate partial interval values beyond UNKNOWN/WIN/DRAW/LOSS occurred on any complete control.
WIN-resolved-by-k state/action regions are upward closed and LOSS-resolved-by-k regions are downward closed under the favorable q order on all tested complete controls.
The finite strong-score chain can be treated as derived from Bellman information outcome plus resolution ordinal rather than as a primitive RBA value carrier.

refined_candidate_core.residual_layer: finite distributive residual lattice derived from board fiber
refined_candidate_core.transition_layer: terminal-extended join-preserving left adjoints with exact right adjoints
refined_candidate_core.draw_semantics: residual exact outcome after finite continuation resolves without forced win/loss

refined_open_region.question: Can the current board-fiber + adjoint transition + four-valued Bellman information + monotone boundary basis be reduced further?
What structural parameter bounds the size of WIN_k/LOSS_k extremal fronts and their composed transformers toward the empty root?
Can multiple Bellman refinement steps over board-fiber transitions be block-composed directly on WIN/LOSS antichain fronts without intermediate rank/support boundaries?
Does the finite full-depth Bellman-information expression admit a compact direct-root normal form?
Is the pair of monotone WIN/LOSS fronts plus iteration ordinal minimal for exact state/action strong values, or is there a smaller compositionally closed representation?
How does the four-valued value-information algebra relate to the proof/controllable-predecessor region and C4-R0043/C4-R0069/C4-R0076?
Which Bellman-information and board-fiber results generalize to finite gravity Connect-K families?
What is the canonical/minimal normal form for a block Bellman-information transformer over fiber transitions?

literature_alignment.raw_complete_shell: generalized strong-preservation partition refinement is demonstrably too fine for the target value semantics
literature_alignment.nonpartitioning_abstraction: monotone antichain boundary domain matches generalized abstract-interpretation models beyond state partitions
literature_alignment.retrograde_partial_information: UNKNOWN/WIN/DRAW/LOSS propagation matches standard partial-information retrograde rules
literature_alignment.caution: No claim yet that RBA-QU-0004 is the unique forward-complete shell in the formal abstract-interpretation sense.
